IPC Section 124A corresponds to BNS Section 132 (Sedition). The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Indian Penal Code, 1860 with effect from 1 July 2024.
IPC Section 377 corresponds to BNS Section 2 (Savings). The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Indian Penal Code, 1860 with effect from 1 July 2024.
IPC Section 497 corresponds to BNS Section 2 (Adulteration of rape). The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Indian Penal Code, 1860 with effect from 1 July 2024.
IPC Section 309 corresponds to BNS Section 2 (Definitions). The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Indian Penal Code, 1860 with effect from 1 July 2024.

IPC Section 153AA corresponds to BNS Section 132 (Punishment for knowingly carrying arms in any procession or organising or holding or taking part in any mass drill or mass training with arms). The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Indian Penal Code, 1860 with effect from 1 July 2024.
CrPC Section 8 corresponds to BNSS Section 2 (Section 1). The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 with effect from 1 July 2024.

CrPC Section 16 corresponds to BNSS Section 267 (Courts of Metropolitan Magistrates). The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 with effect from 1 July 2024.

CrPC Section 17 corresponds to BNSS Section 105 (Power to make sure that the Court is not satisfied). The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 with effect from 1 July 2024.

CrPC Section 18 corresponds to BNSS Section 189 (Special Metropolitan Magistrates). The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 with effect from 1 July 2024.

CrPC Section 19 corresponds to BNSS Section 265J (Security control of the Sessions Judge). The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 with effect from 1 July 2024.
The BNS applies. The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 came into force on 1 July 2024, so an offence committed on 20 June 2024 is dealt with under the BNS and not the IPC.
